differential.name: Chronic kidney disease stage 4 (advanced CKD)
differential.rationale: High creatinine, metabolic acidosis, weight loss after dialysis, and multiple CKD‑related comorbidities.

differential.name: Acute gout flare
differential.rationale: History of gout, CKD‑related hyperuricemia, and moderate pain score (5/10) suggest a possible arthritic episode.

differential.name: Hypoglycemia secondary to diabetes treatment in CKD
differential.rationale: Low random glucose (66 mg/dL) in a patient with type 2 diabetes and reduced renal clearance of insulin/oral agents.

differential.name: Anemia of chronic kidney disease
differential.rationale: Documented anemia and CKD stage 4 make anemia a likely contributor to fatigue and generalized discomfort.

differential.name: Drug‑induced liver injury (mild transaminitis)
differential.rationale: Mildly elevated ALT/AST with normal bilirubin, possibly from medications used for hypertension, gout, or diabetes.
